title: placeholders in args, env values and cwd load; env keys are left alone
rationale: The three expansion sites in one entry, plus an env key that looks like a placeholder and must not be treated as one.
quote: Expansion applies to every string element of `args`, every string value in `env`, and the `cwd` string. It does not apply to `env` keys, `command`, or fixed component locations.
observabilityNote: The load report records that the entry was accepted. The expanded values themselves are subprocess state, outside this contract.
